programme.title: Presto
programme.desc: Presto is a magician. Alec is a rabbit. Presto just wants to perform tricks. Alec just wants to eat a carrot! Follow along with word-for-word narration as these two characters play their best tricks

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Tails, Tricks, And Traps
programme.desc: A fun-filled animated series packed with adventures, pranks, and laughter, showing how characters' mischief creates entertaining, lighthearted, and playful stories.

programme.title: Feast
programme.desc: Winston the Boston Terrier loves his life with his owner, especially the shared snacks. But a new girlfriend brings healthier food, changing their routine .

programme.title: Vee's Tricks And Treats
programme.desc: Vee celebrates Halloween with tricks and treats. Spooky fun, laughter, and surprises remind her that togetherness makes the holiday truly magical.

programme.title: Ariel To The Rescue
programme.desc: An animated adventure featuring Ariel on a rescue mission, blending courage, kindness, and magical charm, inspiring young viewers with values of bravery and compassion.

programme.title: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Baloo and Bagheera thought Mowgli needed their protection at all times, but Mowgli thought differently. Why, he could fight like a bear and plan like a panther, too! Mowgli tries to save his new friend.

programme.title: Elsa's Gift
programme.desc: Queen Elsa and Princess Anna are hosting a ball for the people of Arendelle. Elsa knows it's the perfect time to show everyone how much she loves her sister. But can Elsa find the right gift for Anna?

programme.title: Starry Night
programme.desc: A beautiful animated Disney tale capturing the magic of nights filled with stars, dreams, and emotions, inspiring wonder and the beauty of imagination.

programme.title: Driven To Win
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen loves racing. But when a new racer arrives, will Lightning still be the fastest car on the track?

programme.title: Lead The Way
programme.desc: Follow along with word-for-word naration as Lightning McQueen discovers the wonders and importance of having a special somebody to help lead the way.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Mater
programme.desc: Mater and the Gas Caps, records a hit song, Mater becomes a rock legend. Then Lightning joins Mater's band for the rock concert of the century!

programme.title: Mater Private Eye
programme.desc: Detective Mater is hot on the trail of a dastardly car-napping! When Tiais sister goes missing, Mater is the only car she can turn to. With this tow truck on the case, anything can happen.

programme.title: Radiator Springs 500 1/2
programme.desc: Lightning and his companions concur that Stanley, the man who founded Radiator Springs. Lightning forced to defend Stanley's honour when Sandy interrupt the festivities and challenge him to a race.

programme.title: A Family Mystery
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Coco is the celebration of a lifetime. Follow along as the discovery of a generations-old mystery leads to a most extraordinary and surprising family reunion.

programme.title: Coco
programme.desc: Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning Land of the Dead following a chain of events.

programme.title: Miguel And The Amazing Alebrijes
programme.desc: Goldie and Bear have fun learning to fly with a lost broomstick. But when the owner is found, they must say goodbye. Read this adorable Disney storybook!

programme.title: Budderball'S First Fair
programme.desc: Budderball is most excited about the food at the town fair: cotton candy, popcorn, peanuts-it all sounds so delicious! When the hungry pup stumbles upon a pie-eating contest.

programme.title: Meet The Buddies
programme.desc: Meet the lovable Disney Buddies , perfect for audiences who already know the charismatic Buddies, or anyone who just loves dogs!

programme.title: The Halloween Visitor
programme.desc: The Buddies embark on a Halloween adventure. Trick-or-treating turns spooky when a black cat brings bad luck. They investigate the mysterious visitor and solve the Halloween puzzle!

programme.title: A Day with Papa
programme.desc: Explore Disney's read along as Papa Bunny guides Thumper on manners, teaching important lessons through fun adventures with word for word narration and delightful illustrations for children to enjoy.

programme.title: Thumper And The Egg
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! When Thumper finds an egg, he tries his hardest to keep it happy. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Thumper takes care of his new friend in this Level 1 reader.

programme.title: I Love You, My Bunnies
programme.desc: Thumper and his sisters want to give their mama the perfect gift for Mother's Day. So, they leave their playtime behind and go on an adventure in the forest.

programme.title: Thumper Counts to Ten
programme.desc: Thumper and his sisters laugh, play, and thump their way through a world filled with new discoveries, fun, and forest friends.

programme.title: Grandpa Bunny
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Great Grandpa Bunny Bunny is the ancestral founder of Bunnyville. Follow along with word-for-word narration as he teaches each new generation of bunnies.

programme.title: Please Don't Feed The Tiger Lily
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! One day, a little puppy with nowhere to go arrived at the Main Street USA train station. Seeking for a place to call his own, follow along as the little pup explores the town.

programme.title: A Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Tinker Bell tries her hand at being an animal, water, and light fairy, learning new skills and discovering her hidden talents as she explores the magical world of Pixie Hollow with her friends.

programme.title: Meet Fawn The Animal-Talent Fairy
programme.desc: Fawn loves all the animals in Pixie Hollow. When Fawn makes an unusual furry friend, she must prove to the fairies that they can trust this warm hearted beast.

programme.title: New Friends
programme.desc: Tinker Bell meets a winter fairy named Periwinkle and together they explore the mysterious winter woods!

programme.title: Tink's Treasure Hunt
programme.desc: Tinker Bell ventures beyond Pixie Hollow to patch things up with her friend Terence and restore an ailing Pixie Tree. This reader features the Disney Fairies, based on Tinker Bell and the Lost Treasure.

programme.desc: Read along with Disney! One day, a little puppy with nowhere to go arrived at the Main Street USA train station. Seeking for a place to call his own, follow along as the little pup explores the town.

programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Someone has been going through the fairies'' private things and leaving horrible messes all over Pixie Hollow -- but who could it be?

programme.title: A Perfect Match
programme.desc: Join Tinker Bell on a thrilling adventure and follow along as Tink travels to the forbidden Winter Woods, meets a new fairy named Periwinkle, and discover why her wings begin to sparkle and glow.

programme.title: Adventure at Skull Rock
programme.desc: Tinker Bell and her fairy friends embark on an adventure to retrieve the stolen Blue Pixie Dust from pirates in this Disney Fairies storybook. Follow the narration!

programme.title: Tink'N About Animals
programme.desc: Fawn teaches her fairy friends all about animal groups!

programme.desc: Minnie wants to send Mickey Gingerbread Robots to space. Chip and Dale steal Pluto's cookie delivery! Pluto must now save the cookies and get them safely to Mars.

programme.desc: The Huns invade China, and Mulan, wanting to save her father, disguises herself as a man to join the army. She bravely fights and helps defend China from the invaders.

programme.desc: The Evil Queen is no longer the fairest in the land and orders her Huntsman to kill her. But Snow White is alive and living in the forest. Follow the Evil Queen takes matters into her own hands.

programme.desc: It's Mickey Mouse's birthday, and he's sure his friends are throwing him a party. There's just one problem . . . there are no signs of a party. Have Mickey's friends forgotten all about his big day?

programme.title: Mickey's Christmas Carol
programme.desc: Join Mickey and his friends in a series of tales that will warm your heart. In this story, mean old Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by several ghosts urging him to be more generous and kind-hearted.

programme.title: Mickey'S Spooky Night
programme.desc: Read about your favorite Disney characters and their spooky adventures!

programme.title: Vote For Minnie
programme.desc: Minnie runs for president of the Adventure Club. But Pete is also running! Who will win and be elected the next president?

programme.title: Mickey And The Kitten-Sitters
programme.desc: Enjoy quick, charming Disney and Pixar bedtime stories! Join Anna, Elsa, Mickey, Minnie, and Scamp in exciting adventures. These five-minute tales are perfect for ending the day.

programme.title: Minnie Saves Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: The Haunted Halloween
programme.desc: With this collection of spooky Halloween stories, little ones will be tricked and treated off to sleep with some of their favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

programme.title: Minnie's Surprise
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy are hired to babysit Clara Cluck's egg, but it begins to hatch on their watch! Follow as the Happy Helpers try to get the mama hen and her egg back together in time.

programme.title: Race For The Rigatoni Ribbon
programme.desc: Mickey and the gang head to Italy to compete in the Race for the Rigatoni Ribbon. Do the Roadster Racers have a chance at winning the race? Follow along with word-for-word narration to find out!

programme.title: A Hot-Dog Day
programme.desc: When Minnie plans a picnic for Daisy and friends, they all pitch in with the help of a misplaced basket.

programme.title: Minnie-rella
programme.desc: The fairy tale is based on the story of Cindrella. Minnie Mouse falls asleep while doing chores and dreams that she becomes Minnierella! She needs help to get ready for Prince Mickey's Grand Ball.

programme.title: Colors All Around
programme.desc: Join Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gane as they search for their favorite colors. Follow along with word-for-word narration and help them find all the colors in the rainbow!

programme.title: Mickey Saves Santa
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends are all ready for a Christmas Eve sleepover at the Clubhouse. They've written their lists and can't wait for Santa Claus to arrive. Santa won't be coming unless he gets some help!

programme.title: Mickey's Easter Hunt
programme.desc: The Clubhouse pals are throwing an Easter party and Pete's upset because he thinks he isn't invited. Pete decides to make a change in the Clubhouse, he makes it disappear-with the friends still inside!

programme.title: Mickey's Halloween Treat
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends want to go to the Tower, for the Halloween party but, they have to get there before the moon is full! Toodles and Mouseketools are what Mickey need to find on his way to the tower.

programme.title: Minnie's Rainbow
programme.desc: In this colorful tale, Minnie Mouse simply explains how these beautiful apparitions are formed. Follow the narration as Minnie and her Clubhouse pals begin to see a world of rainbows around them.

programme.title: Top O' The Clubhouse
programme.desc: It's Saint Patrick's Day. Mickey and the gang are ready to celebrate! But when Pete's shenanigans threaten to ruin their celebration, it will take some help from Toodles, to get the party back on track.

programme.title: Homesick
programme.desc: Being sick is no fun for anyone, but Funny's sneezes are extra funny! Every sneeze sends Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gang through the wrong Adventure Doors. Will Funny ever feel better?

programme.title: Donald'S Stinky Day
programme.desc: When Donald accidentally rescues a cute little skunk, the grateful little stinker refuses to leave his side!

programme.title: Mickey'S Perfecto Day
programme.desc: Mickey and the Roadster Racers head to Madrid, Spain for some racing and sightseeing fun. But when a baby bull begins to chase them around town, their perfecto vacation starts to crumble!

programme.title: Ski Trippin
programme.desc: The gang is teaching Daisy to ski when she accidentally ends up in the middle of aa big skiing race! Using the skills she's learned along the way, can she pull off a big win?

programme.title: Hocus Bow-Cus
programme.desc: Minnie is launching her new 'Bows are Magical' fashion line. He forgot his bow tie at home, he rushes off to find it. Millie and Melody rehearsed with Penguini, but will they remember all the tricks?

programme.title: Minnie's Pet Salon
programme.desc: Minnie and friends get ready to pamper their pets at Minnie's Pet Salon! It's a spa day like no other for Pluto, Figaro, Bella, Butch, and Mr. Pettibone!

programme.title: The Case Of The Missing Sparkle-izer
programme.desc: Who's been using Minnie's new Sparkle-izer? When Minnie needs it to decorate her customers' bows, the Super Sparkle-izer turns up missing! It's up to Millie and Melody to solve the mystifying mystery!

programme.title: Always In Fashion
programme.desc: Minnie Mouse is always in fashion! She and Daisy love making bows at Minnie's Bow-tique. All of their friends want Minnie to make them bows.

programme.title: Blooming Bows
programme.desc: Minnie's nieces are very upset! The paper petals on their costumes are falling apart. Now, it''s up to Minnie to redesign the girls' costumes. But can she do it in time for the school's Posy Pageant?

programme.title: Bow-Bot Robot
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy get some help from a bow-making robot in this retelling of an episode of Disney Junior's Minnie's Bow Toons.

programme.title: Easter Bonnet Parade
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! One day, a little puppy with nowhere to go arrived at the Main Street USA train station. Seeking for a place to call his own, follow along as the little pup explores the town.

programme.title: Trouble Times Two
programme.desc: Movie star Penelope Poodle has come to Minnie''s Bow-Tique to find something perfect to wear. But when Minnie''s mischievous twin nieces, Millie and Melody, come for a visit, it''s Trouble Times Two!

programme.title: Year Round Fun
programme.desc: Book with magnet set in a case

programme.title: Riches To Rags
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny
programme.desc: Sofia and her bunny Clover enter a pet contest. Other kids have fancy pets. Sofia must decide: enter with a fancy pet or stay loyal to her best friend, Clover.

programme.title: Clover Time
programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Time for Courage
programme.desc: Follow Mulan's courageous journey as she disguises herself to take her father's place in the Imperial Army, defending China against the Huns in this inspiring story.

programme.title: Honor For Father
programme.desc: Enjoy quick stories with Disney and Pixar girls! Join Moana, Helen Parr, and others on fun adventures. Perfect for bedtime reading in just five minutes!

programme.title: Khan To The Rescue
programme.desc: Mulan's grandmother is missing! Khan the horse alerts Mulan, who sees Grandma's hat and basket. Together, Mulan and Khan bravely search for and rescue her.

programme.title: Aurora's Homemade Holiday
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Listen To Your Heart
programme.desc: Pocahontas faces a tough choice. English settlers arrive, threatening her land and people. She must choose between her heart and protecting her village, seeking a path to peace.

programme.title: Raya'S Team
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Meet Raya, a lone warrior from the fantasy kingdom of Kumandra, and her mighty team.

programme.title: The Fight For Kumandra
programme.desc: It's up to Raya to find the last dragon and save the world of Kumandra!

programme.title: Raya And The Last Dragon
programme.desc: Raya, a warrior, seeks the last dragon to save Kumandra. She unites with a group to restore light and unity to their world in this adventure.

programme.title: Aurora And The Helpful Dragon
programme.desc: When Aurora brings a baby dragon from the forest. The little dragon tries to act like the other castle animals-a cat, a dog, a bird, even a fish-but something goes wrong every time.

programme.title: Anna & Elsa: Olaf'S Perfect Summer Day
programme.desc: Summer is here in Arendelle, and Olaf is very happy! He loves summer days. This story follows Olaf as he enjoys his perfect day in the warm weather.

programme.title: Tiana's Friendship Fix Up
programme.desc: Tiana learns to heal friendships through kindness and trust. Conflicts test her, but love and understanding prove the key to lasting magical bonds.

programme.title: Meet A.R.F
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Bob builds a robotic helper for this pug pups in this Pre-Level 1 reader.

programme.title: Lights, Camera, Perry
programme.desc: Phineas and Ferb enter Perry in a mascot contest, and he becomes famous. But his Agent P fedora is everywhere! Will this fame expose his secret identity? Read to find out!

programme.title: Smitten With A Kitten
programme.desc: After Doc finds a toy kitten, she brings her home to meet the toys. Lambie falls in love with the little kitty and wants to adopt her. But anytime Lambie or the toys come close, the kitten runs away!

programme.title: Sealed With A Kiss
programme.desc: Ariel loves playing hide-and-seek with her little seal friend. But when the princess can't find him anywhere she begins to worry. Ariel searches the ocean to find her friend.

programme.title: Babysitting Mode
programme.desc: Jack-Jack may look like a normal baby, but don't let that cute face fool you! Follow along with narration as his babysitter finds out firsthand that this little guy can do some incredible things.

programme.title: Night Of The Giant Floating Baby Head
programme.desc: Enjoy this two-in-one Halloween-themed book starring Phineas, Ferb, and Perry the Platypus!

programme.title: Babysitter Bunga
programme.desc: Bunga becomes the unorthodox babysitter in the Pride Lands, teaching kids how to defend themselves. Follow the narration as they use his lessons to fight off the jackals!

programme.title: Finding Dory
programme.desc: This is the story of the friendly-but-forgetful blue tang fish as she tries to reunite with her loved ones, and everyone learns a few things about the true meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: Francesco's Rematch
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his racing rival Francesco Bernoulli challenge each other to a race in Monza, Italy-Francesco's hometown. Both Lightning and Francesco are confident they will win the race.

programme.title: Mater And The Ghost Light

programme.title: Redline
programme.desc: Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: John awakens from a coma to discover his wife and daughter were murdered in a brutal home invasion. Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Spytime
programme.desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Wrecker
programme.desc: Two beautiful young women taking a trip through the countryside, are terrorized by an unknown driver trying to run them down in a heavy duty tow truck.

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: New Delhi
programme.desc: An honest journalist is illegally detained in a mental asylum when he tries to expose two corrupt politicians. After his release, he plans to exact revenge on the people who wronged him.

programme.title: Lohe Ke Haath
programme.desc: Gayatri's mother-in-law Bindu Devi tries to set fire to her on her wedding night for her dowry; her husband Jainath is equally responsible for this attempt. Gayatri is saved by Triloki, but he doesn't have good intentions: he rapes her. Gayatri saves another woman from getting molested and both meet Maataji, who is also a victim of dowry. Maataji trains helpless women to fight against injustice and Gayatri turns into a rebel.

programme.title: Gunda Gardi
programme.desc: A righteous police commissioner, Karan Singh, tries to nab the notorious mafia duo, Narasimha and Kalicharan. After his brother-in-law gets murdered, he plans to take help from the eye-witness, Deepa, to get hold of the criminals.

programme.title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
programme.desc: As a newly graduated engineer loses track of what's important, his career starts to rise. When he falls in love with a beautiful young woman, he gets even more confused about what he wants.

programme.title: Saveray Wali Gaadi
programme.desc: Ravidas lives in a village in rural India. He is the son of Chediram who is of highly respected in the village. Ravidas falls in love with Jyoti. Their love becomes known in the village. Because of differences of caste, the villagers are opposed to Ravidas marrying Jyoti. Chediram commits suicide due to the shame his son has brought upon him. Ravidas is a gifted poet, but he cannot fulfill his dream of being recognized as a great poet, his poems being published and shown to the world, because he lives in a village.

programme.title: New Delhi
programme.desc: An honest journalist is illegally detained in a mental asylum when he tries to expose two corrupt politicians. After his release, he plans to exact revenge on the people who wronged him.

programme.title: Maidan E Jung
programme.desc: Arjun learns that his sister loves a man who is about to get married and makes efforts to unite them. But when he learns that his sister's in-laws plan to kill her, he sets out to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Zakhmi Insan (dub) (dass Tamil)
programme.desc: Antony falls in love with Rajeswari who belongs to an upper caste family. When her father kills her sister for marrying a man from the lower caste, she decides to elope with Antony.

programme.title: Kuch Toh Hai
programme.desc: The movie follows the story of a young couple who move into a new house, only to discover that it is haunted by a mysterious presence. As they try to unravel the truth behind the entity, they uncover a dark secret that threatens their very existence.

programme.title: Raja Ki Aayegi Baaraat
programme.desc: Raja rapes Mala and the court orders him to marry her. His family continues to torture Mala and attempts to kill her, but she manages to win over Raja and his family with her good deeds.

programme.title: Sun Zara
programme.desc: Trisha is mesmerised by aspiring singer Rohit's voice. After the two fall in love, Trisha meets with an accident and loses her eyesight.

programme.title: Kuku Mathur Ki Jhand Ho Gayee
programme.desc: A film about a young man named Kuku who dreams of becoming a successful entrepreneur. When he gets a job at a wedding planning company, he sees it as his ticket to the good life. However, his lack of experience and the chaotic wedding planning industry lead to hilarious mishaps and adventures.

programme.title: Special Night Kirtan
programme.desc: An evening devotional program featuring live kirtan and bhajans led by devotees, focusing on communal chanting of the Hare Krishna maha-mantra. The broadcast includes musical accompaniment, brief spiritual reflections, and opportunities for audience participation.

programme.title: Gita Parayan
programme.desc: A devotional program featuring recitations and concise explanations of selected verses from the Bhagavad Gita, accompanied by guided chanting and reflections to support spiritual study and practice.

programme.title: Mangal Aarti ISKCON Vrindavan
programme.desc: A daily morning devotional ceremony from ISKCON's Vrindavan temple featuring traditional aarti, kirtan, and sacred hymns led by temple priests and devotees to invoke spiritual blessings.

programme.title: Mangal Aarti ISKCON Chowpatty
programme.desc: A morning devotional ceremony from ISKCON Chowpatty featuring traditional aarti rituals, Sanskrit chants, and congregational singing led by temple priests. The program offers viewers a serene devotional experience with bhajans and ritual music central to Gaudiya Vaishnavism.

programme.title: Tulsi Aarti & Japa
programme.desc: A daily devotional program from Hare Krsna Channel offering traditional Tulsi aarti followed by guided japa chanting of the Hare Krishna mantra to support meditation and bhakti practice. Suitable for viewers seeking peaceful devotional music and spiritual guidance.

programme.title: Sri Narasimha Mantra Dhyan
programme.desc: A guided devotional session featuring the Narasimha mantra with sustained chanting and gentle instrumental backing to support focused meditation and inner calm. Designed for practitioners and newcomers seeking a devotional mantra practice rooted in traditional Sanskrit recitation.

programme.title: Gita Paath
programme.desc: A program of Bhagavad Gita recitations presented with traditional Sanskrit chanting accompanied by short translations and explanations; designed to support devotional study and understanding for general audiences.

programme.title: Sringar Aarti ISKCON Juhu
programme.desc: A daily devotional ceremony featuring the traditional Sringar Aarti performed at the ISKCON Juhu temple, combining melodic kirtan and deity worship. The program offers serene devotional music and brief spiritual reflections suitable for devotees and general audiences.

programme.title: Karma Yog
programme.desc: A devotional series that explains the philosophy and practice of karma yoga within Krishna consciousness, offering practical guidance, scriptural insights, and devotional examples to help viewers cultivate selfless action in daily life.

programme.title: Choti kahani badi seekh

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show’S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India’S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi’S & Bahu’S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What’S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga’S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga’S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga’S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn’t happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law’s. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law’s family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani’s lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri wakes up and finds Indravadhan still on his chair, guarding her room. She then learns from the secretary that Indravadhan was taking care of her throughout the night. Gayatri does not wake up Indravadhan, instead, she decides to prepare the coffee before waking him up. Gayatri then learns that Indravadhan has decided to sell a fort in order to pay the loan. She then decides to help Indravadhan out in any way possible. She takes the responsibility of cleaning the house in order to save the money that would be paid to the servants. In the process she hurts herself and loses consciousness. The doctor too declares that he cannot save Gayatri now. What would Indravadhan do now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan takes an unconscious Gayatri to the mosque where a Baba treats her. He asks Indravadhan about his whereabouts. Indravadhan does not reveal to the Baba that he is just a soldier. It is also revealed that Kuwar Singh's son has engaged in a gay relationship with a slave. Kuwar Singh scolds his son and asks him to keep in mind that, Indravadhan is not going to leave his throne. Kuwar Singh then asks his son to plan a baby as soon as possible. Kuwar Singh's son claims that he can do anything but will never plan a baby. What will Kuwar Singh's reaction be when he learns this? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri regains her consciousness and finds that Indravadhan's behavior has changed. Gayatri questions Indravadhan as to why he is doing this. Indravadhan claims that he is the one who has hurt her and it is his responsibility to take care of her. On the other hand, Kuwar's son beats up his wife and claims that he does not want to live with her. While Gayatri and Indravadhan on the other hand, are staying in the former's friend's place where they do not get sufficient food for two people. Indravadhan rejects from having the food and asks Gayatri to eat it alone. How will Gayatri convince Indravadhan to share the food? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan cries before Gayatri and claims that he had forgotten to fulfil the responsibility of a husband. Gayatri consoles Indravadhan by saying that he is a good person and knows how to fulfil the responsibilities as common man and as well as a king. Hearing this, Indravadhan leaves Gayatri and walks away. A confused Gayatri thinks as to what wrong she said to Indravadhan. On the other hand, Swarnlekha confronts Kuwar Singh and Kokila and shows her wounds to them. She tells her in-laws that she is going back to her home and is also going to complain about her husband. What will Kuwar Singh and Kokila do now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Indravadhan finds Gayatri missing, he decides to search for her. On the other hand, Gayatri is held at gunpoint. She is then tied up to a chair by the baba and the family with whom Indravadhan and Gayatri were staying. Indravadhan too is held by the family and tied up to a wall. Later, Indravadhan questions Gayatri as to why she did not inform him about anything. Gayatri replies to Indravadhan that he was not ready to hear anything from her. On the other hand, Kuwar Singh and Kokila talk about Swarnlekha and her decision. They decide to talk with their son and convince him. While on the other hand, Gayatri and Indravadhan try to set themselves free and escape. Will Indravadhan and Gayatri be able to set themselves free? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan and Gayatri return home and they are confronted by Raj Mata. Raj Mata acts as though she does not know what actually had happened in the lives of Indravadhan and Gayatri. After the 'Aarti' the couple are welcomed in the house. Later, Indravadhan finds Gayatri struggling to tie a knot at her back. Indravadhan attends her and ties the knot up for her. On the other hand, Kokila meets Swarnlekha and threatens her. While on the other hand, Gayatri is suspicious as to how could Swarnlekha fall sick? Will Gayatri learn about Swarnlekha's condition? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Raj mata spots a spy in the Raj Mahal and follows her. She fails to catch up as the spy manages to evade Raj Mata. The spy then meets Kuwar Singh and gets some orders from him and meanwhile, Raj Mata informs Gayatri about the spy in the Raj Mahal. Later, Gayatri's brother meets her and invites her for an event being held at his home. When Gayatri's brother invites Raj Mata to the event, she declines the invitation. On hearing this, Indravadhan speaks up saying that he would attend the event. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ranaji and Gayatri reach her house for the Pooja. When Gayatri asks whether he is still angry or not, Ranaji says that he left his anger outside. Kuwar's spy follows the two of them to keep an eye on them. Later Damyianti thanks Ranaj for accepting Gayatri as his wife and he is then asked to wear a dhoti for the Pooja. When he struggles with draping himself, Gayatri helps him. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek thi Rani to find out more.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri wakes up and realizes that Indravadhan has not yet returned. She decides to ask her mother where Indravadhan has gone. When Indravadhan comes back she confronts him and yells at him. Indravadhan apologizes to Gayatri and says that he failed to realize her importance in his life. He then puts a bangle around Gayatri's wrist and claims that he has given her all the rights as a queen, and as well as a wife. In return, Indravadhan requests Gayatri to forgive him. The next day, events are held at Gayatri's home in which both she and Indravadhan participate. What are the events that Indravadhan and Gayatri participate in? Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Gayatri finds that her things are missing from her room she asks Ranaji who moved her things. Ranaji says it was on his orders that her things were moved out so they can stay together. What will Gayatri's reaction be with this change in Ranaji? Keep watchin Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri wakes up and finds Indravadhan still on his chair, guarding her room. She then learns from the secretary that Indravadhan was taking care of her throughout the night. Gayatri does not wake up Indravadhan, instead, she decides to prepare the coffee before waking him up. Gayatri then learns that Indravadhan has decided to sell a fort in order to pay the loan. She then decides to help Indravadhan out in any way possible. She takes the responsibility of cleaning the house in order to save the money that would be paid to the servants. In the process she hurts herself and loses consciousness. The doctor too declares that he cannot save Gayatri now. What would Indravadhan do now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan takes an unconscious Gayatri to the mosque where a Baba treats her. He asks Indravadhan about his whereabouts. Indravadhan does not reveal to the Baba that he is just a soldier. It is also revealed that Kuwar Singh's son has engaged in a gay relationship with a slave. Kuwar Singh scolds his son and asks him to keep in mind that, Indravadhan is not going to leave his throne. Kuwar Singh then asks his son to plan a baby as soon as possible. Kuwar Singh's son claims that he can do anything but will never plan a baby. What will Kuwar Singh's reaction be when he learns this? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri regains her consciousness and finds that Indravadhan's behavior has changed. Gayatri questions Indravadhan as to why he is doing this. Indravadhan claims that he is the one who has hurt her and it is his responsibility to take care of her. On the other hand, Kuwar's son beats up his wife and claims that he does not want to live with her. While Gayatri and Indravadhan on the other hand, are staying in the former's friend's place where they do not get sufficient food for two people. Indravadhan rejects from having the food and asks Gayatri to eat it alone. How will Gayatri convince Indravadhan to share the food? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan cries before Gayatri and claims that he had forgotten to fulfil the responsibility of a husband. Gayatri consoles Indravadhan by saying that he is a good person and knows how to fulfil the responsibilities as common man and as well as a king. Hearing this, Indravadhan leaves Gayatri and walks away. A confused Gayatri thinks as to what wrong she said to Indravadhan. On the other hand, Swarnlekha confronts Kuwar Singh and Kokila and shows her wounds to them. She tells her in-laws that she is going back to her home and is also going to complain about her husband. What will Kuwar Singh and Kokila do now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Indravadhan finds Gayatri missing, he decides to search for her. On the other hand, Gayatri is held at gunpoint. She is then tied up to a chair by the baba and the family with whom Indravadhan and Gayatri were staying. Indravadhan too is held by the family and tied up to a wall. Later, Indravadhan questions Gayatri as to why she did not inform him about anything. Gayatri replies to Indravadhan that he was not ready to hear anything from her. On the other hand, Kuwar Singh and Kokila talk about Swarnlekha and her decision. They decide to talk with their son and convince him. While on the other hand, Gayatri and Indravadhan try to set themselves free and escape. Will Indravadhan and Gayatri be able to set themselves free? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan and Gayatri return home and they are confronted by Raj Mata. Raj Mata acts as though she does not know what actually had happened in the lives of Indravadhan and Gayatri. After the 'Aarti' the couple are welcomed in the house. Later, Indravadhan finds Gayatri struggling to tie a knot at her back. Indravadhan attends her and ties the knot up for her. On the other hand, Kokila meets Swarnlekha and threatens her. While on the other hand, Gayatri is suspicious as to how could Swarnlekha fall sick? Will Gayatri learn about Swarnlekha's condition? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Raj mata spots a spy in the Raj Mahal and follows her. She fails to catch up as the spy manages to evade Raj Mata. The spy then meets Kuwar Singh and gets some orders from him and meanwhile, Raj Mata informs Gayatri about the spy in the Raj Mahal. Later, Gayatri's brother meets her and invites her for an event being held at his home. When Gayatri's brother invites Raj Mata to the event, she declines the invitation. On hearing this, Indravadhan speaks up saying that he would attend the event. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ranaji and Gayatri reach her house for the Pooja. When Gayatri asks whether he is still angry or not, Ranaji says that he left his anger outside. Kuwar's spy follows the two of them to keep an eye on them. Later Damyianti thanks Ranaj for accepting Gayatri as his wife and he is then asked to wear a dhoti for the Pooja. When he struggles with draping himself, Gayatri helps him. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek thi Rani to find out more.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri wakes up and realizes that Indravadhan has not yet returned. She decides to ask her mother where Indravadhan has gone. When Indravadhan comes back she confronts him and yells at him. Indravadhan apologizes to Gayatri and says that he failed to realize her importance in his life. He then puts a bangle around Gayatri's wrist and claims that he has given her all the rights as a queen, and as well as a wife. In return, Indravadhan requests Gayatri to forgive him. The next day, events are held at Gayatri's home in which both she and Indravadhan participate. What are the events that Indravadhan and Gayatri participate in? Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Gayatri finds that her things are missing from her room she asks Ranaji who moved her things. Ranaji says it was on his orders that her things were moved out so they can stay together. What will Gayatri's reaction be with this change in Ranaji? Keep watchin Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.
